title: Starting Line
overview: Ashito finally gets the promotion to the A team, and he does everything he can to keep up. However...

title: A Thinking Reed
overview: When Taira and Matsunaga invite Ashito and the others to dinner, Kuribayashi appears and joins them.

title: Premier League Match 7 – Kashiwa Dai Business School
overview: Ashito makes the A team's roster for the Premier League for the match against Kashiwa Dai Business School.

title: Cornerstone
overview: Ashito fails to keep up with the pace of the Premier League, and Kashiwa identifies him as a weak spot.

title: Don't Quit Thinking
overview: Kuribayashi's presence overwhelms Ashito, but he notices something unusual about Kuribayashi's play.

title: Teach Me
overview: Kobayakawa returns from injury. Faced with obvious skill gap with the starters, Togashi takes action.

title: Notebook
overview: Fukuda suggests a drill with ropes at the nighttime practice. Then, Kuribayashi gives a notebook to Ashito.

title: Aim Higher
overview: The reserves surprise the starters in a scrimmage, showing the teamwork and awareness they've built through Fukuda's rope drills.

title: Premier League Match 13: Tokyo VANS Youth
